description: Adds workspace-scoped account records and conservative quota reservations. No production seed data or automatic ownership transfers.

container.controlPartition: workspaceUsage and workspace mutation locks share the selected workspaceId partition; user initialization locks use a user-prefixed partition
container.legacyCompatibility: Existing ownerId records without workspaceId remain visible only in that owner's stable hashed Individual workspace. Backfill must preserve ownerId and parent-child scope.
